name: Giant Frog
appearance: A much larger version of an ordinary frog, with camouflaging coloration. It ranges from two to six feet long and 50 to 250 pounds. At two feet it weighs 50 pounds, increasing by 50 pounds for each additional foot.

habitats: Freshwater habitats shared with large aquatic predators

Hit Dice variants.name: 2 HD
Hit Dice variants.effectNote: The text gives 2 to 4 feet. THAC0 16, bite 1–6, 175 XP. The 2-foot endpoint overlaps the 1 HD description.

Hit Dice variants.name: 3 HD
Hit Dice variants.effectNote: Over 4 feet long. THAC0 16, bite 2–8, 270 XP.

Movement and ambush.name: Jump
Movement and ambush.effectNote: A 50-pound frog can leap up to 180 feet. Subtract 20 feet per additional 50 pounds. It can leap 30 feet straight up. It cannot leap backward or directly sideways.

Movement and ambush.name: Camouflage
Movement and ambush.effectNote: In its natural habitat, opponents take −3 to surprise rolls. It retreats from fire.

Combat.name: Tongue
Combat.effectNote: Its sticky tongue reaches three times its body length and gains a +4 bonus to the attack roll. A hit causes no direct damage. The target gets one chance to strike the tongue before being reeled in. A hit frees the target, and the frog leaves that target alone.

Combat.name: Reeling in prey
Combat.effectNote: A lighter victim is drawn in during the round they miss the tongue. A heavier victim takes one extra round and gets another chance to hit the tongue. A victim more than twice the frog’s weight cannot be drawn in and is released on the third round after capture. The text leaves equal weight unspecified.

Combat.name: First bite
Combat.effectNote: A successful bite in the first round the victim is in reach deals the maximum damage for the frog’s Hit Dice.

Combat.name: Swallow whole
Combat.effectNote: An attack roll of 20 can swallow a victim shorter than 3 feet. A victim has three rounds to escape before asphyxiating. An attack roll of 18 or higher with an edged weapon lets the victim cut their way out. A successful escape kills the frog. Damage dealt to the frog has a 33% chance to also affect the swallowed victim.

notes: 5–40 appearing. Uncommon. Pack organization. Active at any time. Carnivore. No intelligence (0).
Average (8) morale. Treasure, alignment, and magic resistance Nil.
The printed Hit Dice cell reads 1+3. The prose describes 1, 2, and 3 HD versions, which also appear in the THAC0 and XP rows. The profile uses those versions.
Monstrous Manual, TSR 2140, January 1994 third printing, p. 119.

name: Killer Frog
appearance: A smaller, three-foot relative of the Giant Frog with sharp teeth and conspicuous front talons.

Combat.name: Talons and bite
Combat.effectNote: It attacks with front talons and sharp teeth. The table gives 1–2 for each of the first two attacks and 2–5 for the third.

Combat.name: Predation
Combat.effectNote: It pursues prey with its claws and teeth. The entry explicitly excludes swallowing whole.

notes: 3–18 appearing. Very rare. Pack organization. Active at any time. Carnivore. No intelligence (0).
Unsteady (6) morale. Treasure, alignment, and magic resistance Nil.
Monstrous Manual, TSR 2140, January 1994 third printing, p. 119.

name: Poisonous Frog
appearance: A rare form of ordinary small frog. The entry gives no distinct palette or identifying markings.

Combat.name: Bite and contact poison
Combat.effectNote: The bite deals 1 damage. The frog’s poison is delivered by skin contact or by a bite. The victim gets +4 on the saving throw. The entry gives no effect or duration for a failed save.

notes: 2–12 appearing. Rare. Pack organization. Active at any time. Insectivore. No intelligence (0).
